title: Likebisi ya moke Liboso ya moyambi oyo azali kotambola
intro: Kota na lobwaku moko epai wapi mokonzi moko ya nguya mpe moyambi monene bazali kopusana, mpe kanisá naino mobembo moko ya moke azali kopesa likebisi oyo ebikisaka lisanga mobimba. Wana bato ya mboka oyo bazali na likama bakómi na esika ya kobombama, likama yango ezali koleka. Landá bilembo mpo na koyeba motángo oyo bato babosanaka nsima ya likebisi yango.
clues: Nazali kati na bikelamu ya mikemike oyo esanganaka na bokonzi ya mokonzi.
Lisanga na ngai efandaka na bisika ya kofanda na kati ya lobwaku moko, epai wapi moko na biso akoki kobenga basusu.
Tokutani na likama ya mokonzi wana mpe mampinga oyo ezali kosala mobembo elongo na mokonzi.
Ngai nazali kobenga lisanga na ngai mpo na kokota na bisika na bango ya kofanda mpe kokebisa biso ete tonyatama te kozanga koyeba.
Mokonzi azali Sulayman, mpe lolenge na ngai ezali kati na bikelamu oyo batye na nse ya bokonzi na ye.
Nazali fourmi ya lobwaku wana; nsima ya likebisi na ngai, tokotaki na bisika na biso ya kofanda mpe tokimaki konyatama oyo soki te elingaki kokanga biso kozanga koyeba.

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Kebisi oyo ebikisaki lisangá moko ya ba fourmis
Kosɛnga lopɛtɛ epai ya mbisi moko
Koluka kiti ya bokonzi oyo ezangi
trial.answer: Kebisi oyo ebikisaki lisangá moko ya ba fourmis

location.label: Elemento ya ntina
options: Mwana ya Ngombe ya Wolo ya Kobima

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Bato ya mboka babikisamaki nsima ya komibomba
Lisanga yango ebebisamaki kozanga ete ebombama
Bato ya mboka babikisamaki mpo basoda bazongaki nsima
Bato ya mboka yango bazwaki mbano ya kozala na bokonzi likoló ya bandɛkɛ yango
Bamemaki bato ya mboka yango na boombo na ndako ya mokonzi
outcome.answer: Bato ya mboka babikisamaki nsima ya komibomba

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
